en.tagline: Browser automation for AI agents using @e element refs
en.summary: agent-browser lets an AI agent drive a web browser through the belt CLI and inference.sh. It opens pages, reads interactive elements as @e refs, and acts on them with clicks, form fills, drags, uploads and JavaScript. It can also take screenshots and record video of a session.
problem: Automating a web page usually means writing and maintaining selectors for each element. When the page changes, the automation breaks.

With this skill, the agent opens a URL and gets a list of interactive elements, each with a short @e ref. It acts on those refs, then takes a new snapshot after the page changes. Browser state stays inside one session until it is closed.
fit: Extracting data from pages after search or navigation
Recording a browser session for debugging or documentation
unfit: Tasks that need no browser and only call an API
Pages that need a proxy setup you cannot provide, since proxy options depend on your own server details
steps: Run `open` with a URL and `--session new` to start a session and get `@e` refs for the page elements.
Use `interact` with an action such as `fill`, `click`, or `select` and a `ref` to act on one element.
Run `snapshot` after navigation, form submission, or dynamic loading, because refs are invalid after those changes.
Use `screenshot` or `execute` to capture the page or run JavaScript on it when needed.
Run `close` with the session ID to end the session; it returns a video file if recording was turned on.

zh.tagline: 为 AI 智能体提供基于 @e 元素引用的浏览器自动化
zh.summary: agent-browser 让 AI 智能体通过 belt 命令行工具和 inference.sh 操作网页浏览器。它打开页面，将可交互元素读取为 @e 引用，并对其执行点击、填写表单、拖放、上传文件和运行 JavaScript 等操作。它还能截图，并录制会话视频。
problem: 自动化网页操作通常需要为每个元素编写并维护选择器。页面一变，自动化脚本就会失效。
使用这个技能后，智能体打开网址，获得可交互元素列表，每个元素都有一个简短的 @e 引用。它通过这些引用执行操作，页面变化后重新获取快照。浏览器状态保留在一个会话内，直到会话关闭。
fit: 在搜索或导航后从页面提取数据
录制浏览器会话，用于调试或存档
unfit: 只需调用 API、不需要浏览器的任务
需要你无法提供的代理配置的场景，因为代理选项取决于你自己的服务器信息
steps: 使用网址和 `--session new` 运行 `open`，启动会话并获取页面元素的 `@e` 引用。
使用 `interact`，指定 `fill`、`click` 或 `select` 等操作和 `ref`，对单个元素执行操作。
在导航、提交表单或动态加载内容之后运行 `snapshot`，因为这些变化会使引用失效。
需要时使用 `screenshot` 截取页面，或使用 `execute` 在页面上运行 JavaScript。
使用会话 ID 运行 `close` 结束会话；如果开启了录制，它会返回视频文件。
